{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "ProbabilityTheory.sub_half_inf_sub_mem_Ioo",
      "informal_name": "Subtracting Half the Minimum Distance to Endpoints Preserves Open Interval Membership",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {l u v : ℝ}, v ∈ Set.Ioo l u → v - min (v - l) (u - v) / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo l u",
      "informal_description": "For real numbers $ l, u, v $ with $ l < v < u $, the value $ v - \\frac{\\min(v - l, u - v)}{2} $ remains strictly between $ l $ and $ u $, i.e., $ v - \\frac{\\min(v - l, u - v)}{2} \\in (l, u) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Probability.Moments.IntegrableExpMul"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "ProbabilityTheory.add_half_inf_sub_mem_Ioo",
      "informal_name": "Adding Half the Minimum Endpoint Distance Preserves Open Interval Membership",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {l u v : ℝ}, v ∈ Set.Ioo l u → v + min (v - l) (u - v) / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo l u",
      "informal_description": "If $ v $ is an element of the open interval $ (l, u) $, then $ v + \\frac{1}{2} \\min(v - l, u - v) $ is also an element of $ (l, u) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Probability.Moments.IntegrableExpMul"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "add_sub_div_two_lt",
      "informal_name": "Half-Difference Addition Preserves Strict Inequality in Linearly Ordered Fields",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Field α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [PosMulReflectLT α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] {a b : α},\n  a < b → a + (b - a) / 2 < b",
      "informal_description": "For any elements $a$ and $b$ in a linearly ordered field, if $a < b$, then $a + \\frac{b - a}{2} < b$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Field.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "right_sub_midpoint",
      "informal_name": "Right Endpoint Minus Midpoint Equals Half Difference",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : Invertible 2] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module R V]\n  (v₁ v₂ : V), v₂ - midpoint R v₁ v₂ = ⅟2 • (v₂ - v₁)",
      "informal_description": "For any vectors $ v_1 $ and $ v_2 $ in a module over a ring $ R $, the difference $ v_2 - \\text{midpoint}(v_1, v_2) $ is equal to $ \\frac{1}{2} \\cdot (v_2 - v_1) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace.Midpoint"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "sub_self_div_two",
      "informal_name": "Subtraction Identity: $ a - \\frac{a}{2} = \\frac{a}{2} $",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Field α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (a : α), a - a / 2 = a / 2",
      "informal_description": "For any element $ a $ in a field $ \\alpha $, it holds that $ a - \\frac{a}{2} = \\frac{a}{2} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Field.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "left_sub_midpoint",
      "informal_name": "Left Subtraction of Midpoint Equals $\\frac{1}{2}$ the Difference",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : Invertible 2] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module R V]\n  (v₁ v₂ : V), v₁ - midpoint R v₁ v₂ = ⅟2 • (v₁ - v₂)",
      "informal_description": "For any vectors $v_1, v_2$ in a vector space over a ring $R$, the difference $v_1 - \\text{midpoint}(v_1, v_2)$ equals $\\frac{1}{2}(v_1 - v_2)$, where the midpoint is defined as the affine combination $\\text{lineMap}(v_1, v_2, \\frac{1}{2})$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace.Midpoint"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Subtracting Half the Minimum Distance to Endpoints Preserves Open Interval Membership

items.informal_description: For real numbers $ l, u, v $ with $ l < v < u $, the value $ v - \frac{\min(v - l, u - v)}{2} $ remains strictly between $ l $ and $ u $, i.e., $ v - \frac{\min(v - l, u - v)}{2} \in (l, u) $.

items.type: ∀ {l u v : ℝ}, v ∈ Set.Ioo l u → v + min (v - l) (u - v) / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo l u

items.informal_name: Left Subtraction of Midpoint Equals $\frac{1}{2}$ the Difference
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : Invertible 2] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module R V]
  (v₁ v₂ : V), v₁ - midpoint R v₁ v₂ = ⅟2 • (v₁ - v₂)
items.informal_description: For any vectors $v_1, v_2$ in a vector space over a ring $R$, the difference $v_1 - \text{midpoint}(v_1, v_2)$ equals $\frac{1}{2}(v_1 - v_2)$, where the midpoint is defined as the affine combination $\text{lineMap}(v_1, v_2, \frac{1}{2})$.
